title: coronilla glauca subsp. pentaphylla
intro: Coronilla glauca subsp. pentaphylla, commonly known as Pentaphylla or Five-leafed Coronilla, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family. It is a medicinal plant traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as calming and soothing effects. The therapeutic actions of Coronilla glauca subsp. pentaphylla include sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help alleviate stress and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, although further research is necessary to fully understand its properties and effects.
